qualifier: steroid sulfonation and organic anion uptake
name: Drug disposition with steroid sulfonation and organic anion uptake
rationale: Members cover drug ADME, xenobiotic and steroid metabolism, cytosolic sulfonation and SLCO organic anion/glycoside transport; the ADME and SLCO uptake set it apart from the detoxification/catabolism confusables and sulfonation/steroid metabolism from the efflux/bilirubin confusables.

qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
rationale: Members are growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling, thyroid hormone transport/action (with LAT1-type amino acid transport) and organismal growth regulation; thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin distinguish it from IL-6-family, IGF and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

name: Nociceptive detection of thermal and mechanical pain
rationale: All members concern detection of painful thermal/mechanical stimuli, pain behaviour and sensitisation, whereas the confusables are potassium-channel and membrane-potential regulation.

name: Organelle lumen acidification and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members are V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles plus aminophospholipid translocation and ANO6 scrambling, the latter absent from all acidification confusables.

core: B cell and plasma cell signatures
name: B cell and plasma cell transcriptional signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive/memory B and plasma cell immunoglobulin expression modules with plasma cell and germinal centre differentiation; these signatures distinguish it from confusables built on Tfh/ICOS help and B cell proliferation signaling.

qualifier: T follicular helper and ICOS help
name: Germinal center B cell regulation and T follicular help
rationale: Members cover B cell modules, B cell homeostasis and restraint of proliferation/apoptosis, germinal centre formation and Tfh differentiation with ICOS co-stimulation, which the plasma-cell signature and BCR-activation confusables lack.

name: Transferrin- and heme-mediated iron acquisition
rationale: Members are transferrin endocytosis/recycling, DMT1 defects and heme scavenging/transport, whereas the confusables concern free iron ion import, cadmium or copper/manganese handling.

name: Odontogenesis and EDA-NF-kB ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover tooth/dentin/cementum formation, hair placode and ectodermal differentiation with EDA-ID (NF-kB) defects and TNF-family receptor binding; tooth and EDA-ID members separate it from the skin/keratinocyte and enamel-mineralization confusables.

name: PDGF receptor alpha/beta signaling in mesenchymal cells
rationale: Five members regulate or respond to PDGFR-alpha/beta signaling and one is a mesenchymal YAP/TAZ fibroblast module; PDGF signaling is what the stromal ECM and Hippo confusables lack.

name: IL-3/IL-5 and CBL-regulated FLT3 myeloid cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-3, IL-5 and G-CSF signaling and FLT3 signaling via SRC kinases under CBL negative regulation, distinguishing it from common-gamma-chain, EPO/TPO-STAT5 and oncogenic fusion confusables.

qualifier: blood group antigens and selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin ligand biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GDP-fucose metabolism, SLC35C1/SLC35A1 nucleotide-sugar transport, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis, tyrosine sulfation and selectin-dependent leukocyte rolling/HSC homing, which the N/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables lack.

name: Core BMAL1-CLOCK and CRY-PER circadian feedback loop
rationale: All members are steps of the core clock loop (BMAL1/CLOCK expression, modification and activation, CRY:PER repression), unlike the MECP2/NPAS4 and ROR/REV-ERB metabolic-output confusables.

name: Glutathione synthesis, turnover and transport
rationale: Members cover GCLC/GSS synthesis, GGT catabolism, glutathione and cystine transport; the synthesis members distinguish it from the gamma-glutamyl cycle, ROS/ferroptosis and glutamate confusables.

name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial specification in vasculogenesis
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate commitment and arterial, venous and lymphatic differentiation, vasculogenesis and vessel maturation, whereas the confusables are heart, outflow-tract and BMP-driven cardiac development.

name: Suppression of IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF production
rationale: All members negatively regulate production of the innate proinflammatory cytokines IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF, while confusables concern T cell cytokines (IL-2, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21) or Toll/IL-1 signaling.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster and respiratory complex I/III assembly
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly, Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation, inner-membrane protein insertion and complex I/III/ATP synthase assembly; Fe-S assembly and absence of complex IV separate it from the electron-transport and mitochondrial-translation confusables.

name: HRI/GCN2 integrated stress response and translational repression
rationale: Members are eIF2alpha-kinase (HRI, GCN2) responses, mitochondrial UPR and stress-induced control of translation initiation, which distinguish it from ATF6/IRE1/XBP1 ER-UPR confusables.

name: Renin-angiotensin and endothelin control of arterial pressure
rationale: Members regulate systemic/pulmonary blood pressure via angiotensin generation and signaling, endothelin, neural input and vasoconstriction, unlike confusables centred on NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation and renal sodium/bradykinin handling.

name: Cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron development
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granule layer, granule precursor and Bergmann glia development with motor learning, plus pyramidal, thalamic and forebrain neuron specification, distinguishing it from commissure, Purkinje/locomotor, retinal and cortical migration confusables.

qualifier: hindbrain, cranial nerve and spinal cord
name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and spinal cord neuron development
rationale: Members cover brainstem/hindbrain maturation and migration, cranial nerves and ganglia, spinal motor/interneuron specification and dorsoventral patterning, unlike sympathetic, enteric, neural plate and midbrain dopaminergic confusables.

name: HIF-alpha oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation
rationale: All members describe oxygen-dependent HIF-alpha hydroxylation, HIF-1alpha signaling and oxygen homeostasis, unrelated to the erythroid, NRF2 and TCA confusables.

name: Transcriptional regulation of E-cadherin and cadherin-11
rationale: All three members are transcriptional control of CDH1 or CDH11, which none of the EMT, transcription-general, mesenchymal or RUNX3 confusables contain.

name: Regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and angiogenic factor production
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate endothelial sprouting, proliferation, migration and VEGF/FGF/TGF-beta2 production, whereas confusables centre on Tie2, VEGF-receptor binding and VEGFR2 signaling.

name: Visual retinoid cycle in rods and cones
rationale: Members are the rod and cone retinoid cycles, their RDH5/RDH12/LRAT defects and vitamin A metabolism, distinguishing it from A2E/ABCA4, STRA6 and general retinoid metabolism confusables.

name: Wnt secretion, non-canonical signaling and blood-retinal barrier formation
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis/secretion, WNT5A-Ca2+ signaling and FZD internalization, and retinal vessel/RPE and blood-brain/retinal barrier formation, which the PCP, canonical beta-catenin and Hedgehog-lipidation confusables lack.
